about: Bob's judgment of every line's opening (WO-121a Part 4), 21 Oct 2026. Base-game and DLC openings were compared with UESP's pages (url); mod openings were judged from the start check's own evidence in openings-2026-10-21.md. Where a LoreRim mod changes a start, the records win over UESP. verdict: CONFIRMED, NO_GIVER_OK (no single giver is right), WRONG (reason says what's right), UNSURE (the evidence can't settle it; the page says not checked). Bob read every row and agrees with each verdict; three rows reverse his own earlier calls (Blood on the Ice, Ancestral Worship, The Cursed Tribe), see WO-121b.

lines.name: The Dragonborn
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then "Make your way to the Keep"
lines.uesp: Infobox names Ralof, but the quest begins on its own at the execution and Alduin's attack. First objective: "Make your way to the Keep" (obj 30, stage 160)
lines.reason: UESP's "Ralof" is the guide through a quest that starts by itself. In LoreRim, Alternate Perspective owns the start: you either rent a room from Matlara at Helgen (25 gold) or take Shazdehviir's skip. So no single giver is right, and the first step matches UESP and the records.

lines.name: Dawnguard
lines.pageSays: Agmaer, Fort Dawnguard; then "Speak with the leader of the Dawnguard..."
lines.uesp: Giver: city guard, Durak or Agmaer. Durak approaches you to recruit you, guards' rumors can start it, and Agmaer's greeting starts it only if you haven't heard. First objective: "Speak with the leader of the Dawnguard" (stage 10)
lines.reason: The sheet's main route is the DLC1VQ00ChangeLocation messenger (Durak), which starts by itself (LoreRim: level 30, after Laid to Rest), and Agmaer is only a fallback. The page should name no single giver: Durak comes to you, or a guard's rumor, or Agmaer on the road.

lines.name: Dragonborn
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then "Find out who sent the Cultists"
lines.uesp: No infobox giver. Two cultists ambush you in a town after The Way of the Voice. Stage 5: "Find out who sent the Cultists"
lines.reason: It starts with the cultist ambush, which the sheet shows as a story-manager start (LoreRim: level 25 plus a chosen main-quest point), and the first step matches.

lines.name: The Companions
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then "Speak to Kodlak Whitemane"
lines.uesp: Several Whiterun citizens and Jorrvaskr residents can start it, or Aela after the giant fight; all send you to Kodlak. First objective: speak with the leader, Kodlak (stage 10)
lines.reason: Many speakers start it (Aela, Vilkas, Farkas, Skjor, Njada, Torvar in the sheet), so no single giver is right, and the first step matches.

lines.name: The College of Winterhold
lines.pageSays: Faralda, Hall of Countenance, Winterhold College; then "Join the College of Winterhold"
lines.uesp: Faralda at the College entrance bridge starts it with her test. Stage 10: "Join the College of Winterhold"
lines.reason: UESP and the sheet both make Faralda the starter, and the first objective matches.

lines.name: The Thieves Guild
lines.pageSays: Brynjolf, Riften; then "Meet Brynjolf during daytime"
lines.uesp: Giver Brynjolf, Riften. Stage 8: "Meet Brynjolf during daytime"
lines.reason: Giver and first objective match UESP exactly.

lines.name: The Dark Brotherhood
lines.pageSays: Aventus Aretino, Aretino Residence, Windhelm; then "Talk to Aventus Aretino"
lines.uesp: Giver Aventus Aretino. Windhelm rumors add the objective. Stage 5: "Talk to Aventus Aretino"
lines.reason: UESP names Aventus as the giver, and the first objective matches.

lines.name: The Civil War
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then "Clear out Fort Hraggstad"
lines.uesp: Legate Rikke at Castle Dour, Solitude, starts it (Tullius or the guards send you to her). Stage 1: "Clear out Fort Hraggstad"
lines.reason: The sheet shows it starting from CW00A (Imperial Introductions) stages 20/21, which UESP says is Rikke's talk, and nothing shows a mod changed that. The page should name Legate Rikke, Castle Dour, Solitude.

lines.name: The Bards College
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then "Investigate the Bards College"
lines.uesp: Giver: any bard. Stage 10: "Investigate the Bards College"
lines.reason: Any bard starts it (Karita, Viarmo, Sven, Ogmund, Mikael in the sheet), so no single giver is right.

lines.name: Vigilant
lines.pageSays: Altano, Temple of Stendarr, Stuhn Ravine; then "Join the Vigilants of Stendarr"
lines.reason: The sheet's only Altano line is a refusal ("No, thanks. I'm not interested.") that sets stage 5, and the quest itself starts by itself through Vigilant - Delayed Start (level 25, after The House of Horrors and Kindred Judgment). So it isn't clear Altano is what starts it, and the page leaves out those conditions.

lines.name: Meridia's Order
lines.pageSays: Paladin Marith, Meridia's Sanctum; then "Speak with High Priestess Alara at Meridia's Sanctum"
lines.reason: Every Marith answer ("You lead, I'll follow", "Lead the way", even the refusal) sets stage 10, and the first step sending you to Alara makes sense.

lines.name: Penitus Oculatus
lines.pageSays: Commander Maro, Penitus Oculatus Outpost, Dragon Bridge Garrison; then "Speak to Commander Maro for assignments"
lines.reason: Maro's "Yes, I want to join" plainly sets stage 1, and its first step points back to him. It is gated on zzzPOLegionRequirementMet, which the page could mention.

lines.name: A Daedra's Best Friend
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then "Speak to Lod, Falkreath's blacksmith, about a dog he's looking for"
lines.uesp: A Falkreath guard mentions the dog once you're high enough level. Stage 5: "Speak to Lod"
lines.reason: The starter is any one of four unnamed gate-guard aliases (level 10 or higher), so no named giver is fair, and the first step matches. The page could add "a Falkreath gate guard".

lines.name: A Night To Remember
lines.opening: Participate in a drinking contest with Sam Guevenne (DA14Start)
lines.pageSays: Sam Guevenne, The Bee and Barb; then "Participate in a drinking contest with Sam Guevenne"
lines.uesp: Sam Guevenne challenges you. Once you reach the required level he can appear in any pub or tavern. Lead-in: "Participate in a drinking contest with Sam Guenvere"
lines.reason: The giver is right but the place is wrong. The sheet's start is a story-manager node on entering any habitation (LoreRim: level 20, via TimingIsEverything), so Sam turns up in whatever inn you walk into, not specifically the Bee and Barb.

lines.name: Boethiah's Calling
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then "Find the Sacellum of Boethiah"
lines.uesp: No single giver: read Boethiah's Proving, go to the Sacellum, or get attacked by cultists. Obj 1: "Find the shrine of Boethiah"
lines.reason: Both UESP and the sheet show it starting by itself (level-up node, LoreRim level 20). The objective text "Sacellum" comes from the winning record, so it stands.

lines.name: Discerning the Transmundane
lines.pageSays: Urag gro-Shub, The Arcanaeum; then "Ask Urag about the insane book"
lines.uesp: Giver Septimus Signus. Stage 5: "I've been given a book of bizarre ramblings..." with objective "Ask Urag about the insane book". It also starts automatically during Elder Knowledge or Scroll Scouting
lines.reason: The quest starts when you're given Septimus's book (stage 5), and Urag only sets stage 10. A first step of "ask Urag" means Urag isn't the starter, but neither UESP nor the sheet says who hands you the book.

lines.name: Ill Met By Moonlight
lines.pageSays: Mathies, Corpselight Farm; then "Speak to Sinding"
lines.uesp: Giver Mathies or Sinding. It begins with Mathies at Corpselight Farm. Stage 10: "Speak to Sinding"
lines.reason: Giver, place and first objective all match UESP and the sheet.

lines.name: Pieces of the Past
lines.pageSays: Silus Vesuius, Silus Vesuius' House, Dawnstar; then "Speak to Silus inside his house"
lines.uesp: Giver Silus Vesuius, Dawnstar (or a museum pamphlet via courier at level 20). Stage 10: "Speak to Silus inside his house"
lines.reason: Giver and first objective match.

lines.name: The Black Star
lines.pageSays: Aranea Ienith, Shrine of Azura; then "Find the elven mage from Aranea's vision"
lines.uesp: Giver Aranea Ienith at the Shrine of Azura. Stage 10: "Find the elven mage from Aranea's vision"
lines.reason: Giver and first objective match.

lines.name: The Break of Dawn
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then "Find Meridia's beacon"
lines.uesp: Meridia's voice, after you find the Beacon in a boss chest or climb Mount Kilkreath (level 12 in vanilla). Stage 50, obj 5: "Find Meridia's beacon"
lines.reason: It starts by itself on level-up (LoreRim: level 20) with no NPC giver, and the first objective matches.

lines.name: The Cursed Tribe
lines.pageSays: Chief Larak, Larak's Longhouse, Mor Khazgur; then "Read the letter from Largashbur"
lines.uesp: No formal giver. After the required level you arrive at Largashbur, help fight the giant, and Atub asks for Troll Fat and a Daedra Heart (stage 50)
lines.reason: The Quest Expansion letter line works for Chief Larak, Burguk or Mauhulakh, and only if you are an Orc or Blood-Kin. Otherwise the level-up node (level 20) starts it by itself and you go to Largashbur. So the page should name no single giver, not Larak alone.

lines.name: The House of Horrors
lines.pageSays: Vigilant Tyranus, Silver-Blood Inn, Markarth; then "Search the abandoned house"
lines.uesp: Giver Vigilant Tyranus. The Silver-Blood Inn keeper mentions him, and he waits outside the abandoned house in Markarth. Stage 10: "Search the abandoned house"
lines.reason: Giver and first objective match. UESP places Tyranus outside the abandoned house rather than in the inn, and LoreRim gates the start node with ANDR_HouseOfHorrorsStatus.

lines.name: The Mind of Madness
lines.pageSays: Dervenin, Temple of the Divines, Solitude; then "Gain access to the Pelagius Wing of the Blue Palace"
lines.uesp: Giver Dervenin, a mad beggar in Solitude. Stage 10: "Gain access to the Pelagius Wing of the Blue Palace"
lines.reason: Giver and first objective match. LoreRim's delayed start (ANDR_DA15_Ready) changes when he offers it, not who offers it.

lines.name: Saints and Seducers
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then "Enter the Asylum"
lines.reason: The sheet shows this quest starting only at the end of an earlier quest, The Route of Madness (EC_SS_MQ100Int, stage 100), and doesn't trace how that one starts. No single giver is fine for this quest, but the line's real way in may be The Route of Madness, which the page doesn't mention.

lines.name: The Only Cure
lines.pageSays: Kesh the Clean, Shrine of Peryite; then "Obtain some Vampire Dust"
lines.uesp: Giver Kesh the Clean at the Shrine of Peryite (an Afflicted Refugee may point you there). Stage 10, obj 11: "Obtain some Vampire Dust"
lines.reason: Giver and first objective match UESP and the sheet.

lines.name: The Taste of Death
lines.pageSays: Eola, Hall of the Dead, The Reach; then "Clear the Draugr from Reachcliff Cave"
lines.uesp: Eola speaks to you when you enter Markarth's Hall of the Dead, and the quest starts whatever you answer. Stage 10: "Clear the Draugr from Reachcliff Cave"
lines.reason: Giver and first objective match. The sheet's hall-scene trigger and Eola's lines agree.

lines.name: The Whispering Door
lines.pageSays: Balgruuf the Greater, Dragonsreach; then "Find out what's wrong with Nelkir"
lines.uesp: Giver Hulda at The Bannered Mare (a rumor, after Dragon Rising), with Balgruuf. Asking Balgruuf about his children doesn't activate it. Lead-in: "Ask about Balgruuf's strange children", then DA08 stage 10: "Find out what's wrong with Nelkir"
lines.reason: Balgruuf's line ("I've heard there's trouble with your children") assumes you've already heard Hulda's rumor. A player needs to start with Hulda at The Bannered Mare, then Balgruuf.

lines.name: Waking Nightmare
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then "Speak to Erandur"
lines.uesp: Infobox giver Erandur, but it starts by overhearing Dawnstar residents talk about nightmares. Stage 20: "Speak to Erandur"
lines.reason: Many Dawnstar residents start it (Brina, Skald, Madena, Rustleif, Leigelf, Frida, Beitild), and the first step names Erandur, which is right.

lines.name: Sleepwalking Into A Nightmare
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then "Find a way to escape The Nightmare." (checked: not yet)
lines.reason: The only start is a helper quest with a RalfornAlias whose own start the records don't show. It may be a Ralforn conversation, but the sheet can't confirm who or what triggers it.

lines.name: Wyrmstooth
lines.pageSays: Theodyn Bienne, Wyrmstooth; then "Speak to Lurius Liore at The Bannered Mare in Whiterun"
lines.reason: Theodyn is the right giver, but he is kept in a holding cell and comes to find you ("I was asked to find you as soon as possible", level 10 or higher, after the starter fires on a location change). Saying he is at Wyrmstooth sends players to the wrong place.

lines.name: Journey to Baan Malur
lines.pageSays: Adimmisaru, Arena Market; then "Solve the dispute."
lines.reason: For this quest, Adimmisaru's line plainly sets stage 10 and "Solve the dispute" makes sense. The sheet's note that the line itself has no single opening (ferry or Kalbthurz) still applies at line level.

lines.name: Siege at Icemoth
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then "Travel to Fort Icemoth"
lines.reason: It runs from game start with no speaker, and its first step points to a jetty marker, so no giver is right. The sheet doesn't show what sets stage 10.

lines.name: The Gray Cowl of Nocturnal
lines.opening: The Call of Gray Cowl of Nocturnal (manny_GF_MQ)
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then "Reach the place"
lines.reason: It starts by itself on a location change once Under New Management reaches stage 200, and the first step points at Seviana Umbranox. No giver is right, though the page could mention the Thieves Guild requirement.

lines.name: The Forgotten City
lines.pageSays: Cassia, Forgotten Ruins; then "Read Cassia's Plea."
lines.reason: Cassia's greeting ("That's close enough - who are you?") plainly starts the quest, and reading her plea is a sensible first step.

lines.name: Gravewind
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then "Explore the strange homestead."
lines.reason: It runs from game start with no speaker, so no giver is right, and exploring the homestead is a sensible first step.

lines.name: Raven Rock
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then "Kill the ash spawn attacking Captain Veleth"
lines.uesp: Giver Captain Veleth. You find him fighting ash spawn at Old Attius Farm, south of Raven Rock, and helping him starts it. Stage 30, obj 10: "Kill the ash spawn attacking Captain Veleth"
lines.reason: UESP names Captain Veleth as the giver and Old Attius Farm as the place, and the records (started from DLC2Init at game start) don't change that. The page should name Veleth at Old Attius Farm.

lines.name: Thirsk Mead Hall
lines.pageSays: Bujold the Intrepid, Bujold's Retreat; then "Join the assault on Thirsk Mead Hall"
lines.uesp: Giver Bujold at Bujold's Retreat, east of Thirsk (the Geldis Sadri rumor is bugged). Stage 10: "Join the assault on Thirsk Mead Hall"
lines.reason: Giver, place and first objective match.

lines.name: Neloth of Tel Mithryn
lines.pageSays: Neloth, Tel Mithryn; then "Find Varona"
lines.uesp: Giver Neloth (or finding Varona's body), after Varona goes missing. Stage 150: "Find Varona"
lines.reason: Giver and first objective match UESP and the sheet.

lines.name: Skaal Village
lines.pageSays: Tharstan, Greathall, Skaal Village; then Travel to Vahlok's Tomb
lines.uesp: Tharstan seeks you out in Skaal Village after A New Source of Stalhrim; stage 10 'Travel to Vahlok's Tomb'
lines.reason: The giver and the first objective both match UESP and the records.

lines.name: The Black Books
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then Learn the Black Book's hidden knowledge
lines.uesp: Started by reading the Black Book Untold Legends in Benkongerike Great Hall; stage 10 'Learn the Black Book's hidden knowledge'
lines.reason: It starts when you read the book, not from an NPC, and the first objective matches.

lines.name: The Ebony Warrior
lines.pageSays: Ebony Warrior, Ebony Warrior's Camp; then Talk to the Ebony Warrior
lines.uesp: At the level threshold the Ebony Warrior approaches you in a major city; stage 10 'Talk to the Ebony Warrior' (the journal says he tried to talk to you on the streets of the city); his camp only comes later as the Last Vigil
lines.reason: The giver is right but the place is wrong: he finds you in Whiterun, Riften, Windhelm, Markarth or Solitude (story node, level 40 in LoreRim per Global Modifiers, not UESP's 80), and the camp is the stage-100 destination.

lines.name: Deathbrand
lines.pageSays: Geldis Sadri, The Retching Netch; then Learn more about the buried treasure
lines.uesp: Giver is 'Reading Deathbrand' (the book) once you reach the level gate; asking Geldis Sadri for rumors is an alternative; stage 29 'Learn more about the buried treasure'
lines.reason: The main start is the book or the level-up helper (level 20 in LoreRim per the record, 36 per UESP); Geldis is only a side route, and his line's conditions (stage 20 done yet stage <= 1) look like they may never fire, so the page should show no single giver.

lines.name: Unearthed
lines.pageSays: Ralis Sedarys, Solstheim; then Fund the excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow (1000 gold)
lines.uesp: Ralis Sedarys outside Kolbjorn Barrow; stage 40 'Fund the excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow (1000 gold)'
lines.reason: The giver and the first objective match; 'Solstheim' is broad but correct (he is outside Kolbjorn Barrow).

lines.name: Filial Bonds
lines.pageSays: Wulf Wild-Blood, Wulf Wild-Blood's House, Skaal Village; then Look for Wulf's brother Torkild
lines.uesp: Wulf Wild-Blood in Skaal Village; stage 10 'Look for Wulf's brother Torkild'
lines.reason: Matches UESP exactly.

lines.name: The Kagrumez Gauntlet
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then Find Resonance Gems across Solstheim to complete the Kagrumez trials
lines.uesp: No giver listed; begins with acquiring Kagrumez Resonance Gems; stage 10 'Find Resonance Gems across Solstheim to complete the Kagrumez trials'
lines.reason: UESP names no giver either, and the first objective matches.

lines.name: Miasma
lines.pageSays: Haj-Xul, The Retching Netch, Solstheim; then Follow Haj-Xul
lines.reason: Haj-Xul's 'Lead the way' / 'Follow me. It's not far from here.' plainly sets stage 10, and 'Follow Haj-Xul' fits.

lines.name: Destroy the Acolyte Priests
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then Destroy Ahzidal
lines.reason: The only starter is a change-location story node after The Fate of the Skaal, so no NPC gives it, and 'Destroy Ahzidal' at Kolbjorn Barrow makes sense.

lines.name: The Forsworn Conspiracy
lines.pageSays: Eltrys, The Warrens, Markarth; then Go to the Shrine of Talos
lines.uesp: Eltrys, or automatic after reading the note he hands you on entering Markarth; stage 15 'Go to the Shrine of Talos'
lines.reason: The giver and the first objective match; Eltrys lives in the Warrens and the first step sends you to the shrine.

lines.name: Promises to Keep
lines.pageSays: Louis Letrush, The Bee and Barb, Riften; then Listen to Louis Letrush's offer
lines.uesp: Louis Letrush at the Bee and Barb; stage 5 'Listen to Louis Letrush's offer'
lines.reason: Matches UESP exactly.

lines.name: Unfathomable Depths
lines.pageSays: From-Deepest-Fathoms, Haelga's Bunkhouse, Riften; then Speak to From-Deepest-Fathoms
lines.uesp: From-Deepest-Fathoms (lives in Haelga's Bunkhouse, wanders outside Riften Fishery) at level 14+; objective 10 'Speak to From-Deepest-Fathoms'
lines.reason: The giver, her home and the first objective all match UESP (her NPC page gives Haelga's Bunkhouse).

lines.name: The Wolf Queen Awakened
lines.pageSays: Elisif the Fair, Blue Palace; then Ask Falk Firebeard about Wolfskull Cave
lines.uesp: Giver Falk Firebeard; start by talking to Varnius Junius, Elisif, Sybille Stentor or Falk in the Blue Palace; objective 15 'Ask Falk Firebeard about Wolfskull Cave'
lines.reason: UESP lists Elisif as one of the valid starters, her line sets stage 15, and the first step correctly points to Falk.

lines.name: Lights Out!
lines.pageSays: Jaree-Ra, Red Wave, Solitude; then Accept Jaree-Ra's offer in Solitude
lines.uesp: Jaree-Ra in Solitude; stage 10 'Listen to Jaree-Ra's offer in Solitude'
lines.reason: The giver matches; the objective wording comes from SaveTheIcerunner.esp, which wins the record, so the records win.

lines.name: In My Time Of Need
lines.pageSays: Alik'r Warrior, Whiterun; then Find the Redguard woman
lines.uesp: Alik'r Warriors in Whiterun; stage 10 'Find the Redguard woman'
lines.reason: Matches UESP exactly.

lines.name: Missing In Action
lines.pageSays: Fralia Gray-Mane, House Gray-Mane, Whiterun; then Meet Fralia at her home in the evening.
lines.uesp: Idolaf Battle-Born, Avulstein or Fralia Gray-Mane; stage 10 'Meet Fralia in her home'
lines.reason: Fralia is a UESP-listed giver; the 'in the evening' wording comes from TheChoiceIsYours.esp, which wins the record.

lines.name: Rise in the East
lines.pageSays: Orthus Endario, East Empire Company, Windhelm; then Steal Suvaris Atheron's logbook...
lines.uesp: Orthus Endario at the East Empire Company office in Windhelm; MS10 stage 10 'Steal Suvaris Atheron's logbook'
lines.reason: The giver and the first objective match; the longer wording comes from TheChoiceIsYours.esp.

lines.name: Blood on the Ice
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then Get assistance from the authority figure
lines.uesp: A Windhelm guard at the murder scene in the graveyard, once you've entered Windhelm 4+ times, at night; stage 10 'Question the witnesses'
lines.reason: The first step is wrong: 'Get assistance from <AuthorityFigure>' (QOBJ 1) is UESP's later stage-110 objective, while the guard's own line ('ask some of these gawkers') sets stage 10 = 'Question the witnesses', and the page should name a Windhelm guard at the graveyard crime scene.

lines.name: The White Phial
lines.pageSays: Nurelion, The White Phial, Windhelm; then Retrieve the White Phial
lines.uesp: Nurelion in The White Phial, Windhelm; stage 10 'Retrieve the White Phial'
lines.reason: Matches UESP exactly.

lines.name: The Golden Claw
lines.pageSays: Lucan Valerius, Riverwood Trader, Riverwood; then Retrieve the Golden Claw
lines.uesp: Lucan Valerius (or overheard from bandits in Bleak Falls Barrow); stage 10 'Retrieve the Golden Claw'
lines.reason: Lucan is UESP's main giver and the first objective matches.

lines.name: Laid to Rest
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then Talk to the Jarl of Morthal
lines.uesp: Morthal guards, Idgrod Ravencrone, Sorli the Builder or Jonna; stage 20 'Talk to the Jarl'
lines.reason: Several people can start it, and the first objective matches (wording from TheChoiceIsYours.esp).

lines.name: A Return To Your Roots
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then Discover the significance of Crimson Nirnroot
lines.uesp: Picking up a Crimson Nirnroot or reading Sinderion's Field Journal in Blackreach; stage 15 'Discover the significance of Crimson Nirnroot'
lines.reason: It starts from an item or journal, not a person, and the first objective matches.

lines.name: The Heart of Dibella
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then Enter the Temple of Dibella
lines.uesp: Giver Hamal (after you're caught in the Inner Sanctum); vanilla stages 0-30 are unrecorded; first recorded objective is stage 60 'Find the future Sybil of Dibella'
lines.reason: The Quest Expansion mod wins the record and adds the stage-55 'Enter the Temple of Dibella' step, but the sheet shows nothing that sets stage 55, so I can't tell whether there's a giver (UESP's vanilla giver is Hamal).

lines.name: The Blessings of Nature
lines.pageSays: Danica Pure-Spring, Temple of Kynareth, Whiterun; then Inspect the Temple of Kynareth
lines.uesp: Danica Pure-Spring (T03Intro: 'Talk to Danica about the Gildergreen'); agreeing sets T03 stage 20 'Retrieve Nettlebane'; 'Inspect the Temple of Kynareth' is listed only as an unknown objective
lines.reason: The giver is right, but Danica's 'I'll get Nettlebane for you' sets stage 20, whose objective on UESP is 'Retrieve Nettlebane'; the page shows the unused QOBJ 10 text instead.

lines.name: The Book of Love
lines.pageSays: Dinya Balu, Temple of Mara; then Talk to Fastred
lines.uesp: Dinya Balu in the Temple of Mara, Riften; stage 10 'Talk to Fastred'
lines.reason: Matches UESP exactly.

lines.name: Seeking A Cure
lines.pageSays: Urag gro-Shub, The Arcanaeum; then Speak to Urag
lines.uesp: Vanilla VC01 is 'Rising at Dawn': innkeepers, Falion and others point you to Falion; stage 50 'Speak to Falion'
lines.reason: Rising at Dawn Quest Overhaul (via RADQO_COTN_Patch.esp) wins the record, renames the quest and moves the start to Urag (his lines set stages 1/3/5), so the records win over UESP's vanilla start.

lines.name: Falion's Secret
lines.pageSays: Falion, Falion's House, Morthal; then Inform the Jarl of Morthal about Falion's activities
lines.uesp: Falion: follow him from his house at 1am to the summoning circle, confront him, then report him to the Jarl of Morthal
lines.reason: The giver and the report-to-the-Jarl step match; the confrontation itself happens at the summoning circle, not in his house.

lines.name: Repentance
lines.pageSays: Illia, Darklight Tower; then Help Illia reach the top of Darklight Tower
lines.uesp: Illia in Darklight Tower; stage 10 'Help Illia reach the top of Darklight Tower'
lines.reason: Matches UESP exactly.

lines.name: Siege on the Dragon Cult
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then (Optional) Find Skorm Snow-Strider's journal
lines.uesp: Captain Valmir calls to you in the Forelhost courtyard; stage 10 '(Optional) Find Skorm Snow-Strider's journal' plus 'Obtain Rahgot's mask'
lines.reason: The 'Grifter' alias whose lines set stages 2/3/10 ('The general has sent me...') is Captain Valmir per UESP, so the page should name him at Forelhost; the first objective is fine.

lines.name: The Pale Lady
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then (Optional) Learn more about the theft in Frostmere Crypt
lines.uesp: No giver; starts on witnessing the bandit attack outside Frostmere Crypt or reading Eisa's journal; stage 1 '(Optional) Learn more about the theft in Frostmere Crypt'
lines.reason: It starts by itself at the crypt, and the first objective matches.

lines.name: Forbidden Legend
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then Investigate the cryptic message
lines.uesp: Giver 'Various' (Lost Legends book, cryptic messages in several ruins); stages 6-9 'Investigate the cryptic message'
lines.reason: There are several ways in and no single giver, and the first objective matches.

lines.name: A Scroll For Anska
lines.pageSays: Anska, High Gate Ruins; then Find And Return Anska's Scroll To Her
lines.uesp: Anska in High Gate Ruins; stage 10 'Find And Return Anska's Scroll To Her'
lines.reason: Matches UESP exactly.

lines.name: Ancestral Worship

lines.name: Kyne's Sacred Trials

lines.uesp: Froki Whetted-Blade at Froki's Shack; stage 21 'Defeat the Guardian Mudcrab/Skeever/Wolf'

lines.name: Trius' Trinket
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then Search the wreck below for the jewelry box.
lines.uesp: Listed under Unfinished Quests: Trius would have asked you outside a shipwreck, but Trius does not appear in-game; objective 10 'Search the wreck below for the jewelry box.'
lines.reason: The records show only a change-location node, which fits 'no giver', but UESP says this is cut vanilla content whose giver doesn't exist, and nothing on the sheet shows it was restored and can actually fire in LoreRim.

lines.name: Infiltration
lines.pageSays: Brurid, Treva's Watch; then Join with Stalleo or deal with him
lines.uesp: Vanilla: Stalleo outside Treva's Watch; stage 10 'Use the backdoor to gain access to Treva's Watch'
lines.reason: Infiltration - Quest Expansion.esp wins the record and adds Brurid's 'I'll get rid of him for you' line, which sets stage 5 'Join with Stalleo or deal with him', so the records win over UESP's vanilla start.

lines.name: Evil in Waiting
lines.pageSays: Valdar, Valthume Vestibule, Valthume; then Collect the Vessels (0/3)
lines.uesp: The ghost Valdar in Valthume Vestibule; stage 3 'Collect the Vessels (x/3)'
lines.reason: Matches UESP exactly.

lines.name: Silenced Tongues
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then "Locate The Ceremonial Weapons"
lines.uesp: Giver: Heddic's Volunruud Notes (book) in Volunruud; stage 10 objective "Locate The Ceremonial Weapons"
lines.reason: No NPC gives it and the first objective matches UESP; the page could add that reading Heddic's Volunruud Notes in Volunruud is what starts it.

lines.name: Yngol's Barrow

lines.uesp: No giver (Giver field blank); a non-journal quest: get the Coral Dragon Claw, solve the barrow puzzle; UESP says its objectives exist in the files but are never set to display
lines.reason: UESP agrees there is no giver; the objective comes from the USSEP-won record, but UESP says vanilla never shows it, so it may not appear in the journal unless USSEP fixed that.

lines.name: The Affairs of Hagravens

lines.uesp: Giver: Melka (imprisoned in Blind Cliff Cave); stage 15 objective "Kill the Hagraven Petra"
lines.reason: The giver and the first objective both match UESP and the records.

lines.name: Telrav's Request

lines.uesp: Giver: Telrav; stage 10 objective "Escort Telrav to his camp."

lines.name: Search and Seizure

lines.reason: The giver and the first objective both match UESP and the records.

lines.name: Extracting an Argonian

lines.reason: UESP names Sondas as the example resident, and in LoreRim only his lines (Dialogue Patch and Finding_Derkeethus) set stage 10, so the records support naming him.

lines.name: Dark Ancestor

lines.uesp: Giver: Dengeir of Stuhn (after stealing Lod's letter for him); "Destroy the vampire Vighar" is stage 10 of FreeformFalkreathQuest03B, and "Tell Dengeir that Vighar is dead" is stage 20 of FreeformFalkreathQuest03
lines.reason: The page shows the objective the player actually sees first (from the 03B part); the sheet's "Tell Dengeir" step is the later stage of the 03 record.

lines.name: Drowned Sorrows
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then "Find out about Isabelle Rolaine in Winterhold"
lines.uesp: Giver: Dagur at The Frozen Hearth, after you settle Ranmir's debt for Haran; journal stages aren't listed on UESP
lines.reason: UESP names Dagur as the giver, and his line "What can be done about it now?" sets stage 10 (the first objective); Haran's lines only call Start, so the page should name Dagur, The Frozen Hearth, Winterhold.

lines.name: The Forgemaster's Fingers
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then "Find the Forgemaster's Fingers"
lines.uesp: Giver: Radiant (approach an Orc stronghold and speak with a member); stage 10 objective "Find the Forgemaster's Fingers"
lines.reason: It's a radiant start from a story-manager event with any stronghold member, so no single giver is right, and the objective matches.

lines.name: Lost to the Ages
lines.pageSays: Katria, Arkngthamz; then "Reach the summit of Arkngthamz"
lines.uesp: Giver: reading The Aetherium Wars, entering Arkngthamz, or finding one of the four shards; reading the book adds an objective to investigate Arkngthamz, and Katria shows up later inside, where stage 100 is "Reach the summit of Arkngthamz"
lines.reason: The quest starts before Katria appears (the book, or the change-location helper the sheet found), so the page should say no one giver: read The Aetherium Wars or go to Arkngthamz, where Katria offers to help.

lines.name: A Forgotten Blade
lines.pageSays: Fultheim, Nightgate Inn; then "Speak to Delphine about Fultheim"

lines.name: Destroy the Dragon Cult

lines.name: Granite Hill

lines.reason: No starter was found in the records or scripts (checked: not yet).

lines.reason: The sheet shows only a story manager node that starts it by itself on a location change, so naming no giver is right and the courier step fits.

lines.name: The Wintersand Deception

lines.reason: No starter was found in the records or scripts, so the sheet can't show whether it starts by itself or from someone.

lines.uesp: Maramal (Temple of Mara, Riften; first found preaching at the Bee and Barb) starts it when you ask about marriage; the first journal objective, at stage 20, is "Speak to Maramal about arranging your wedding" (stages 0-15 have no objectives)
lines.reason: The giver and first objective match UESP and the records (Maramal's TemplePriest lines set stage 10, and the objective comes at stage 20).

lines.name: Inigo
lines.pageSays: Inigo, Riften Jail; then "Get to Snowpoint Beacon and talk to Inigo."
lines.reason: Inigo's own pain lines start and move it on while he follows you (they need his follower dialogue at stage 30 or later), so he is the right giver; Riften Jail is only where you find him, not where it fires.

lines.name: Gore
lines.pageSays: Eden, Dead Man's Drink; then "Head to Peak's Shade Tower outside of Falkreath."
lines.reason: Eden's 'Anything interesting going on around here?' line starts the quest, and the first step points at Peak's Shade Tower.

lines.name: Remiel
lines.pageSays: Remiel, Silver-Blood Inn; then "Speak to Calcelmo about the spider in the excavation site."
lines.reason: Remiel's 'Fine.' / 'Yes! Alright!' exchange sets stage 10, which is the Calcelmo step.

lines.name: Lucien
lines.pageSays: Lucien Flavius, Dead Man's Drink; then "Take Lucien to Dumzbthar"
lines.reason: Lucien's lines carry it from stage 5 up to stage 30, where he marks Dumzbthar, so he is the right giver.

lines.name: Serana
lines.pageSays: Serana, Dimhollow Cavern; then "Ask Urag-gro-Shub for books"
lines.reason: Serana's 'You got a deal!' line sets stage 10 and the first step points at Urag; Dimhollow is just where you first meet her.

lines.name: Auri
lines.pageSays: Auri, Auri's House, Falkreath; then "Take Auri to Moss Mother Cavern"
lines.reason: Auri's 'miss the forest' line sets stage 10, the Moss Mother Cavern step.

lines.name: Katana and Megara
lines.pageSays: Katana, The Winking Skeever; then "Talk to Katana when you have a moment"
lines.reason: Katana's 'I have something for you' line starts the quest, and the first step points back at her.

lines.name: Fura Bloodmouth
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then "Bring Fura to her mother"
lines.reason: It starts from one conversation, not by itself, and the reply ('Lord Harkon will be proud of me...') and the first step show the speaker is Fura, so the page should name Fura; the records don't tag the speaker, so check where she is in-game.

lines.name: Faralda
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then "Bring Faralda's family letter to Vekel the Man"
lines.reason: A single conversation starts it, and the replies ('my letter to my aunt') and the step 'Faralda's family letter' show the speaker is Faralda, so she should be named; the records don't tag the speaker.

lines.name: Jenassa
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then "Travel to the tower where Jenassa met her first love"
lines.reason: It starts from one conversation whose reply ('Let's go, my patron...') and first step are Jenassa's, so she should be named rather than no giver; the records don't tag the speaker.

lines.name: Mjoll the Lioness
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then "Clear the dungeon with Aerin and Mjoll"
lines.reason: A helper quest with Mjoll and Aerin, running from the start of the game, sets stage 10 at its own stage 20, but the sheet doesn't show what pushes the helper to stage 20 (it may be talking to Mjoll and Aerin), so 'no giver' can't be confirmed.

lines.name: Erik the Slayer
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then "Speak to Aela about Erik joining the Companions"
lines.reason: It starts when the player tells one person 'I can make you a Companion if you want', and that person's reply ('Truly?...') and the step about Erik joining show it is Erik, so he should be named; the records don't tag the speaker.

lines.name: Missives
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then "Collect Letter"
lines.reason: No starter was found in the records or scripts, so the sheet can't show how it is picked up.

lines.name: Bounties and favours for the jarls
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then "Kill the bandit leader located at the bounty location"
lines.reason: Whoever fills the Steward or Innkeeper alias at run time gives it, so many people can, and the first step is the bandit-leader bounty.

lines.name: Favours for townsfolk
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then "Deliver the item to the target"
lines.uesp: Radiant favour from any of six people (Adonato Leotelli, Aeri, Banning, Idgrod the Younger, Sondas Drenim, Thadgeir): ask how you can help and they hand you an item; first objective "Deliver <Alias=QuestItem> to <Alias.ShortName=Target>"
lines.reason: The page matches the base game, but in LoreRim all six start lines (won by Favor Quests Seperated.esp) now need TRUEGlobal == 0 while it is 1, so Favor001 can't start; the line should point at the separate delivery quests that mod adds, which aren't in this sheet.

lines.name: Thane of every hold
lines.pageSays: no one giver; then "Assist the people of The Reach (0/5)"
lines.uesp: You get it by speaking to a hold's jarl after befriending them (Balgruuf can't give it in Whiterun unless he's been replaced); stage 10 reads "Assist the people of the Reach (x/5)", but the hold named depends on where you are, and the Rift doesn't show its objectives
lines.reason: Having no single giver is fine (there are nine jarls), but the page's first step names only The Reach; it should say to speak to the jarl of a hold you've helped and give the objective as 'Assist the people of <that hold>'.

lines.name: Fishing

lines.reason: Faendal's line sets stage 20, the training step pointing at Angi; Valdr (Moss Mother Cavern) has the same line, and the quest itself is switched on when you enter Falkreath.

lines.name: Odd jobs in the Rift

lines.reason: Svana's 'Do you work here?' line starts it, and her offer line sets stage 20, the Tythis step.

lines.uesp: Hillevi Cruel-Sea (market stall, Windhelm) starts it when you talk to her; first objective (stage 10) "Deliver the Nightshade Extact [sic] to Wuunferth the Unliving"

lines.name: Odd jobs in Whiterun Hold

lines.uesp: Either Sven (Sleeping Giant Inn) or Faendal can start it; first objective (stage 10) "Deliver Faendal's letter to Camilla"
